architecture.mapping: One unconstrained learned linear readout D(theta,embedding), shared across shapes and densities. Each theta initialized randomly on managedCUDA; no operator coefficients or per-mode oracle values assigned.
architecture.pressure_decode: DCT-II(q), divide nonconstant coefficients by learned D, inverse DCT-II, fix pressure gauge. Constant mode excluded. Require finite positive learned response before deployment.

objective: Equal-scene weighted native coefficient residual: ((D(theta,embedding)*P_native-Q_native)/Q_native_request_RMS)^2. No target coefficient ratios or fitted CPU preprocessing.
pressure_equation_input: Full native same-request rhs*1000*cells_per_metre; zero/fine/coarse future-transition targets are not mixed.
